title: Team
tenant_hint: Switch to role-based access in Admin → Access to grant roles here
everyone_on_team: Everyone in the organization is on the team
about_1: Choose who works here: the people working on {project}, a subset of {org}, each with a role on this project.
about_2: Adding someone writes a role grant to {org}'s access config — the same store the Studio PDP enforces. New people are invited on the organization's People page first.
tenant_title: {org} uses tenant access: there is no per-project team to manage.
tenant_body: Switch to Role-based access in Admin → Access to grant roles to specific people here.
in_access_title: Managed on the organization's Access screen
remove_body: Their role on this project goes. They stay in the organization, and can be added back.
